issues.issue: Five statement lines are split by fund column into governmental and business-type pieces: receipts[4]/[5], receipts[10]/[11], disbursements[2]/[3], [4]/[5] and [6]/[7]. The pieces match the printed columns (General/Street/Keno/Debt Service/CDA vs Water/Sewer), add to the Total column and are marked split_from/computed. This is the extractor's fund-type rule for village all-funds statements, but it conflicts with the instruction that statement lines come only from the Total column. Confirm the fund-type split is intended.
